global: A bowl of spicy ramen broth glows warmly under dim lighting, its rich red hue hinting at bold flavor. Fresh cilantro and bean sprouts crown the surface, nestled in a white ceramic bowl against a dark wooden backdrop.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, forming an oval-shaped background around the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly curved rim, and faint reddish-brown decorative pattern along inner edge.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, bean sprouts, and cilantro, glossy surface with visible seasoning specks and thin noodle strands.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved handle, partially submerged in broth.
